BEFORE YOU CLOCK IN

A few quick
answers.

How do I start playing?

Open Disaster Delivery on Roblox, join the game, and head to Dispatch at spawn for your first job. Your starter scooter gets you on the road. Spawn and manage vehicles at the adjacent garage.

Can I play on my phone or with a controller?

The game includes mobile controls and controller support alongside keyboard and mouse. Graphics presets let you choose the balance that suits your device.

How does cargo capacity work?

Your vehicle determines how many cargo slots you have. Bigger vehicles carry more, and some parcels use more than one slot. Check a contract’s requirements before accepting.

Do I need a pass to play?

No. You can take the free mixed delivery offer and progress through the game. Optional passes add reward boosts, eligible order choices, or premium vehicles.

Can I buy a vehicle on this website?

Purchases and ownership are handled inside Roblox. This showroom is a guide to the fleet. Open the game to view your owned vehicles, current prices, upgrades, and test drives.

Does this website show live game data?

No. Vehicle information and feature notes describe the development build. This site does not access your Roblox account, inventory, or currency, and the published game may differ while updates are in development.
